acceptance: A server bound to `.../benchbox-site.git` answers `expect_store="BenchBox-dev/BenchBox"` with the `E_STATE` gate; a server bound to `.../BenchBox.git` accepts it in any letter case, with or without `.git`.
A regression test in tractable covers the prefix case and the exact-match case.
The todo skill text that says the match is a substring is updated to describe the new rule, and BenchBox pins the fixed runtime.
description:
Defect, reported from a session in the benchbox-site checkout on 2026-11-12 (not reproduced here). `get_instructions(expect_store="BenchBox-dev/BenchBox")` passed on a server bound to `https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site.git`, because the check is a case-insensitive substring match on the remote and `benchbox-dev/benchbox` is a substring of `benchbox-dev/benchbox-site`. The guard exists to stop writes to the wrong project's tracker; for this pair of repositories it cannot. The session noticed only by reading the bound-store text.

Expected: the check compares the whole `owner/repo` (case-insensitive, optional `.git`), so a sibling repository whose name extends the expected one is refused with the existing gate.

Guardrails: this is a change in the tractable product, not in BenchBox; deliver it there and bump the pinned runtime here. Do not weaken the gate to a warning. Keep accepting a full URL or `owner/repo` form.
